gpt-4o-mini.explanation: Atul Gawande examines the medical profession's role in end-of-life care, balancing medical intervention with quality of life.

gpt-4o-mini.explanation: This insightful examination by [Author] delves into the medical practices and healing traditions on Southern slave plantations, highlighting the intersection of health, power, and resilience within enslaved communities. gemma2:9b.explanation: Explores the history of genetics and its impact on medicine and society.
